request.description: The display message this resource's kind declares for a code, for a refusal the controller renders outside a dispatch. `data` is held to the code's declared `data` schema first, exactly as at a dispatch exit.

data.description: The refusal's data, the display message's values.

response.description: The display message's record, nearest along `extends` or the built-in one for an ambient code; nothing when no declaration gives the code one.

displayMessage.description: The text a person is shown for the failure, as its record; its values are `data`.

text.description: The Message in its fragment spelling: a pattern, or a plural selection.
